北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京小雨，体感微凉，记得带伞，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has light rain and feels cool. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行请注意安全，多喝水润润喉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy. Drive safely and stay hydrated!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感舒适，记得添衣哦，别着凉了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels pleasant. Remember to dress appropriately to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感温暖，注意防晒，保持心情舒畅。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm. Protect yourself from the sun and keep a happy mood.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴好，气温适宜，外出散步，感受阳光吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant. Go for a walk and enjoy the sunshine!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，空气湿润，开车慢点，注意路况哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and humid. Drive slowly and be aware of road conditions.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，湿度 100%，出行务必注意交通安全！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is very foggy with 100% humidity. Please be extra careful on the road!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都下雨，湿度 100%，出门带伞，小心路滑。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is rainy with 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for slippery roads.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，湿度很高，注意交通，添衣保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and humid. Mind the traffic and dress warmly.
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感舒适，户外活动注意防风哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels comfortable. Be mindful of the wind for outdoor activities.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感温暖，保持愉悦，享受生活！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and warm. Stay cheerful and enjoy life!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感较冷，多穿点，注意防寒保暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels quite cold. Dress warmly to protect against the chill!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感微凉，记得适时添衣，别感冒了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to add layers to avoid catching a cold.
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感凉爽，早晚温差大，注意增减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy and feels cool. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，空气湿润，出行慢行，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy and humid. Drive slowly and keep a good mood.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感微凉，湿度大，记得带伞哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cool with high humidity. Remember your umbrella!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感较冷，多穿衣，注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cold. Dress warmly to protect against wind and cold.
